title: Three 9-foot skeletons vanish overnight

tellings.quote: So he laid them out, three bodies. They were at least 9 ft tall each. Next day, they were gone.

plain: Sometime between 1978 and 1981, at the Church of Santa Anastasia in Sardinia, a man is said to have laid out three skeletons, each at least nine feet tall, only for them to be gone the next day. Tim Alberino, a guest who says he has looked into giants, tells it second-hand from someone who told him: "So he laid them out, three bodies... Next day, they were gone." If true, it would point to giant human remains being found and then quietly removed.
